additions: "Textured hair" is hair that is coiled, curly, or wavy.

, a study of all hair types and textures, including coil, curl, or wave patterns, hair strand thicknesses, and volumes of hair,

; providing services to individuals with all hair types and textures, including coil, curl, or wave patterns, hair strand thicknesses, and volumes of hair;
